mbsItinerary.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): MBS TRAVELLED TO CAIRO — HIS FIRST TRIP SINCE PARIS. MBS met Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in Cairo on Tuesday Sep 15, where the two called for free navigation in the Red Sea after Riyadh vowed a firm response to Houthi attacks; Saudi also informed European customers that some late-September crude cargoes will be cancelled (Reuters, three sources). The read: with Washington refusing direct military help, MBS is working the Arab/Mediterranean axis instead. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-13): NO NEW MBS TRIP SINCE PARIS — but MBS spent the week on the phone to Washington. Reuters (Sep 11-12, confirming an earlier Axios report): MBS called President Trump AT LEAST TWICE on Thursday Sep 10 to request US military help against the Houthis after the East-West pipeline attack and the Houthi seizure of Mokha and Perim island; Washington told Riyadh it was not willing to take direct military action for now but would help with intelligence sharing and targeting — the White House is 'not enthusiastic about getting involved'. Trump (Saturday, asked about the call): Iran was 'probably' behind the pipeline attack, adding 'he's a good friend of mine, and I can just say everything's going to work out fine and dandy'; he also said of increasing military pressure on Iran, 'Maybe I don't do that because of the election.' The tell: Saudi Arabia is now the supplicant in the relationship, and the US answer was partial — the first real test of the alliance since the crisis began. Also in the window: Oman's Sultan Haitham bin Tarik paid a 'fraternal visit' to Saudi Arabia on Sep 1, meeting MBS in Jeddah with the Saudi energy, foreign, commerce, tourism, transport and investment ministers plus the intelligence chief present — Oman is the venue for the GCC–Iran shipping talks on Monday Sep 14. PRIOR: MBS's Paris state visit Aug 22-24 (first foreign trip since the crisis; Macron at the Esports World Cup, agreements on health/transport/energy, mooted €6B Dragon Ball theme park). Bloomberg (Sep 4): the Esports World Cup was moved out of Riyadh because of the Iran war. Foreign-policy lean unchanged — Saudi is courting Paris to diversify beyond Washington. Updated 2026-09-20
mbsItinerary.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-20）：MBS出访开罗——巴黎以来首次外访。MBS 9月15日（周二）在开罗会见埃及总统塞西，二人呼吁红海航行自由（此前利雅得誓言对胡塞袭击作出强硬回应）；沙特同时告知欧洲客户部分9月下旬原油货载将被取消（路透，三名消息人士）。解读：在华盛顿拒绝直接军事援助后，MBS转向经营阿拉伯/地中海轴。前情（核查于2026-09-13）：巴黎之后MBS无新出访——但本周他把时间花在与华盛顿通话上。路透（9月11-12日，证实此前Axios报道）：东西管道遇袭与胡塞夺取摩卡和丕林岛后，MBS于9月10日（周四）至少两次致电特朗普总统，请求美军对胡塞提供军事支援；华盛顿告知利雅得暂不愿采取直接军事行动，但将提供情报共享与目标定位协助——白宫'并不热衷于介入'。特朗普（周六，被问及通话）：伊朗'可能'是管道袭击的幕后黑手，并称'他是我的好朋友，我只能说一切都会好起来，安然无事'；谈及对伊加大军事压力时又说，'也许因为选举我暂不这么做'。关键信号：沙特如今在这段关系中成了求助方，而美方只给出部分答复——这是危机爆发以来对同盟的首次真正考验。同窗口另讯：阿曼苏丹海赛姆9月1日对沙特进行'兄弟般访问'，在吉达会见MBS，沙特能源、外交、商务、旅游、交通、投资部长及情报总长均在场——阿曼正是9月14日（周一）海合会-伊朗航运谈判的举办地。前情：MBS巴黎国事访问8月22-24日（危机以来首次外访；马克龙出席电竞世界杯；签署卫生/交通/能源协议；传闻中的€60亿Dragon Ball主题公园）。彭博（9月4日）：电竞世界杯因伊朗战争从利雅得移址。外交取向未变——沙特正拉拢巴黎以多元对冲华盛顿。更新于 2026-09-20

singaporeStance.value: Officially neutral, adjusting quietly — AI hub role growing

singaporeStance.threshold_zh: 新加坡选边=其他亚洲盟友已经在做了
singaporeStance.note: No formal policy shift this cycle. Singapore continues 'neutral AI hub' positioning: NAIS refresh (May 2026, PM-chaired National AI Council, four National AI Missions, NVIDIA research lab, Punggol robot testbed); actively marketing access to BOTH US frontier models and Chinese ones as reason for fund managers to stay vs HK; US-Singapore Critical & Emerging Technology Dialogue advancing (security/commercial balance). Manus case (Beijing ordered Meta to unwind $2B acquisition of Singapore-redomiciled Manus, Dec 2025) still tests 'China-shedding' model. Gulf capital flows into Singapore as safe haven possible amid Hormuz war but no policy shift. ASEAN Chair 2027 gives SG agenda power on regional AI norms. No formal policy shift confirmed through Sep 13. Updated 2026-09-20
singaporeStance.note_zh: 本周期无正式政策立场变化。新加坡继续'中立AI枢纽'定位：NAIS更新（2026年5月，总理任主席的国家AI委员会、四大国家AI使命、英伟达研究实验室、榜鹅机器人测试场）；积极营销可同时接入美国前沿模型和中国模型作为基金经理留在新加坡而非迁往香港的理由；美新关键新兴技术对话推进中（安全与商业平衡）。Manus案（北京2025年12月命令Meta撤销对注册于新加坡的Manus的$20亿收购）仍在考验'中国剥离'模式。霍尔木兹战争下海湾资本可能流入新加坡避险，但无政策变化。2027年东盟轮值主席国给予新加坡地区AI规范议程权。截至9月13日无正式政策立场变化。更新于 2026-09-20

adbLoanCurrency.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): still no ADB or World Bank RMB loan-currency disclosure found. Adjacent institutional signals: the World Bank is set to PHASE OUT lending to China by 2031; ADB and the World Bank signed a $3 billion sovereign exposure exchange agreement to boost ADB's lending capacity across Asia-Pacific; WBG Finances One shows China's IBRD vote share at 5.75% (as of Mar 31). RMB internationalisation inputs remain strong: record August trade surplus ($119.09B), USD/CNY 6.7075 (Sep 11, RMB +5.82% YoY), CFETS 101.64 (Sep 4). Hormuz dynamics keep RMB-denominated energy settlement channels (China-Russia, China-Iran) relevant; China is on track to import roughly the same crude volume in September as August, recovering from June's decade low. Gulf states meet Iran in Oman on Sep 14 to discuss a temporary shipping arrangement. No new ADB/World Bank RMB loan data confirmed through Sep 13. Updated 2026-09-20
adbLoanCurrency.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：仍未发现亚行或世行的人民币贷款币种披露。相邻机构信号：世界银行将在2031年前逐步退出对华贷款；亚行与世行签署$30亿主权风险敞口交换协议，以提升亚行在亚太的贷款能力；WBG Finances One显示中国在世行的IBRD投票权份额为5.75%（截至3月31日）。人民币国际化输入仍强：8月创纪录贸易顺差（$1190.9亿）、USD/CNY 6.7075（9月11日，人民币同比+5.82%）、CFETS 101.64（9月4日）。霍尔木兹动态使人民币计价能源结算渠道（中俄、中伊）持续相关；中国9月原油进口量预计与8月大致持平，从6月的十年低点回升。海湾国家将于9月14日在阿曼与伊朗会面讨论临时航运安排。截至9月13日无亚行/世行人民币贷款新数据确认。更新于 2026-09-20

hkmaInterventions.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): STILL NO INTERVENTION; DBS SEES SLIM NEAR-TERM ODDS. USD/HKD continued to hug the weak side of the 7.75-7.85 band through mid-September without pressing the 7.85 Convertibility Undertaking; DBS (Sep 17) expects 'moderately higher HKD rates' from Fed tightening and the Hong Kong Five-Year Plan and sees 'slim chances for near-term HKMA intervention at the weak side of the band at this stage'. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-13): NO HKMA INTERVENTION CONFIRMED. USD/HKD printed 7.8420 on Sep 11 (7.8421 Sep 9; 7.8407-7.8409 Sep 4; 7.8429 Aug 31) — still hugging the weak side of the 7.75-7.85 band but drifting no weaker: the 52-week range is 7.7658-7.8476, so the pair has not pressed the 7.85 Convertibility Undertaking. Carry-trade mechanics unchanged: HIBOR near zero versus USD rates keeps the weak bias, and Fed Chair Warsh's rate-hike hints could widen the differential into Q4 — but nothing has forced the HKMA to sell USD since the June 2025 episode (US$1.2B; the last prior trigger was May 2023 at HK$9.42B). Regional context: record China trade surplus + a firm RMB (USD/CNY 6.7075) plus Gulf safe-haven flows are supporting HK liquidity rather than draining it; Hong Kong equities have been volatile (a Hang Seng Tech rout was flagged on Sep 11). Watch whether a Gulf-risk-driven capital flight bid for HKD develops if the Oman talks on Sep 14 fail. Updated 2026-09-20
hkmaInterventions.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-20）：仍未干预；星展认为近期触发概率很低。9月中旬USD/HKD继续贴近7.75-7.85区间弱方，但未触及7.85弱方兑换保证；星展（9月17日）预计美联储收紧与香港五年规划将推动港息'温和走高'，并认为'现阶段近期在弱方触发金管局干预的机会很小'。前情（核查于2026-09-13）：未确认金管局干预。USD/HKD 9月11日报7.8420（9月9日7.8421；9月4日7.8407-7.8409；8月31日7.8429）——仍贴近7.75-7.85区间弱方，但并未进一步走弱：52周区间为7.7658-7.8476，未触及7.85弱方兑换保证。套息机制不变：HIBOR接近零 vs 美元利率维持弱方偏向，美联储主席沃什的加息暗示可能扩大利差至四季度——但自2025年6月事件以来（$12亿；此前一次触发为2023年5月、HK$94.2亿）尚无因素迫使金管局抛美元。区域背景：创纪录中国贸易顺差+人民币坚挺（USD/CNY 6.7075）叠加海湾避险资金流入，支撑而非抽走香港流动性；港股波动较大（9月11日恒生科技指数下挫被点名）。关注9月14日阿曼谈判若失败、海湾风险驱动的资金避险是否对港币形成买盘。更新于 2026-09-20

chinaGoldImportPath.value_zh: 伦敦→香港回运加速 · 央行8月+65万盎司（+20.2吨，连续第22个月，2023年10月以来最大）· 持有量创纪录7,673万盎司（约2,386吨）· 外储$3.4383万亿 · 香港金库容量目标200吨→2,000吨
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold: Route change = settlement system de-dollarization in motion
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold_zh: 路径改变=结算体系去美元化在进行
chinaGoldImportPath.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): 22ND STRAIGHT MONTH OF BUYING — AND THE BIGGEST MONTHLY ADD SINCE OCT 2023. PBoC data published Sep 7: gold reserves rose by 650,000 troy ounces in August versus end-July, taking holdings to a RECORD 76.73 million oz (~2,386 tonnes) — the largest monthly increase since October 2023, and a 22nd consecutive month of accumulation (Central Banking/TASS/SAFE). China's total FX reserves stood at $3.4383 trillion at end-August, up $19.5bn (+0.57%) on July; SAFE attributed both increases to a lower US dollar index, uneven moves in global financial assets and exchange-rate changes. Note the pace: +1.2t (Jan), +20t (Jul), +20.2t (Aug) — deliberate, accelerating, price-insensitive accumulation. Repatriation/hub build-out: Bloomberg (Aug 7) — the PBoC has built up gold inventories in Hong Kong over recent months, accelerating a longer-term trend of moving reserves home from London, and plans to continue; Hong Kong has launched trial operations of its gold clearing and settlement system and plans to expand storage capacity from 200 tonnes to more than 2,000 tonnes over three years; PBoC Governor Pan Gongsheng said the central bank will continue allocating national foreign reserves to Hong Kong. Trade-side: WGC — China's net gold imports were 152t in June (highest since March 2024), with H1 imports of 764t, +138% YoY. Global backdrop: record 289t of net central-bank purchases in Q2 plus 23t in July (WGC); Poland +90t YTD (640t, target 700t); Bank of Korea's first official gold allocation in 13 years (Aug 3). Parallel: China's reported Treasury holdings fell $73.4bn YoY, near a 17-year low as a share of reserves. Route change + repatriation = reserve de-dollarisation in motion. Updated 2026-09-20
chinaGoldImportPath.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：连续第22个月增持——且为2023年10月以来最大单月增幅。央行9月7日发布数据：8月黄金储备较7月末增加65万盎司，持有量创纪录达7,673万盎司（约2,386吨）——2023年10月以来最大单月增幅，连续第22个月增持（Central Banking/TASS/外管局）。8月末中国外汇储备$3.4383万亿，较7月增加$195亿（+0.57%）；外管局将两项增加归因于美元指数回落、全球金融资产价格走势不一以及汇率折算变化。注意节奏：1月+1.2吨、7月+20吨、8月+20.2吨——刻意、加速、对价格不敏感的囤积。回运/枢纽建设：彭博（8月7日）——央行近几个月在香港建立黄金库存，加速将储备从伦敦运回国内的长期趋势，并计划继续；香港已启动黄金清算与结算系统试运行，计划三年内将存储容量从200吨扩至2,000吨以上；央行行长潘功胜表示将继续把国家外汇储备配置到香港。贸易端：世界黄金协会——中国6月净进口黄金152吨（2024年3月以来最高），上半年进口764吨、同比+138%。全球背景：二季度央行净购金创纪录289吨+7月23吨（WGC）；波兰年内+90吨（640吨，目标700吨）；韩国央行13年来首次正式配置黄金（8月3日）。并行：中国报告的美债持有同比减少$734亿，占外储份额接近17年低点。路径改变+回运=储备去美元化进行中。更新于 2026-09-20

pewFavorability.value: China ~51% · US ~37% (Spring 2026, 36-37 countries) — CROSSOVER: China now rated above the US in 25 of 36 countries
pewFavorability.value_zh: 中国约51% · 美国约37%（2026年春，36-37国）——反超：中国在36国中的25国好感度高于美国
pewFavorability.threshold: US declining across allies; China stable-low but improving in Global South
pewFavorability.threshold_zh: 美国在盟友中好感度持续下降；中国稳定偏低但在全球南方改善
pewFavorability.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): THE FAVOURABILITY CROSSOVER HAS HAPPENED — China is now viewed more positively than the United States in most of the countries surveyed. Pew Research Center Spring 2026 Global Attitudes Survey (released Jul 15, 2026; 45,658 respondents across 37 countries for the China report, 42,151 across 36 for the comparison report; fieldwork Feb 8-May 13, 2026): across 37 countries the MEDIAN favourable view of China is 51% (39% unfavourable); across 36 countries the median favourable view of the US has fallen to 37% (57% unfavourable). China is seen more positively than the US in 25 countries; the US leads in only six — India, Japan, the Philippines and South Korea plus two others. More people now have confidence in Xi Jinping than in Trump in 22 countries; median confidence in Trump is just 23% with 76% expressing none. Biggest gaps are in Asia-Pacific and the Middle East. Canada illustrates the swing: 2023 — US 57% favourable, China 14%; now — China 44%, US 33%. China's ratings are at or near historic highs in Colombia, Greece, Hungary, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Peru, Singapore, Sri Lanka and Turkey — in several of which US ratings are at record lows. Interference perception: a median of 75% in 17 middle-income countries say the US interferes in other countries' affairs a great deal/fair amount, vs 45% for China; in nearly every country more people see the US as the interferer. Personal freedoms remain the one area where the US is rated higher than China, but that gap is narrowing because the US share has collapsed — in Mexico 35% say China respects its people's freedoms vs 20% for the US. Still-negative pockets: 70%+ unfavourable views of China in Japan, Israel, the US, South Korea and Sweden; Singapore is a clear exception to the wealth/negativity pattern (above-median favourability toward China despite the highest GDP surveyed). Dashboard impact: this is the first release in which the US loses the median-favourability contest to China, and it validates the 'dollar system erosion + US alliance strain' leg of the chain. Next survey expected late 2026/2027. Updated 2026-09-20
pewFavorability.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：好感度反超已经发生——中国在多数受访国家中形象优于美国。皮尤研究中心2026年春季全球态度调查（7月15日发布；中国报告样本45,658人、覆盖37国，对比报告42,151人、覆盖36国；实地调查2026年2月8日-5月13日）：37国中位对中国好感51%（不好感39%）；36国中位对美国好感降至37%（不好感57%）。中国在25个国家好感度高于美国；美国仅在六国领先——印度、日本、菲律宾、韩国等。22个国家中信任习近平者多于信任特朗普者；对特朗普的中位信任度仅23%，76%表示不信任。差距最大在亚太和中东。加拿大最具代表性：2023年美国好感57%、中国14%；现为中国44%、美国33%。中国在哥伦比亚、希腊、匈牙利、印尼、马来西亚、墨西哥、尼日利亚、秘鲁、新加坡、斯里兰卡、土耳其的好感度处于或接近历史高位——其中数国美国好感度创历史新低。干涉观感：17个中高收入国家中位75%认为美国大量/一定程度干涉他国事务，中国为45%；几乎每个国家认为美国是干涉者的人都更多。个人自由仍是美国评价高于中国的唯一领域，但差距在收窄，因美国得分大幅下滑——墨西哥35%认为中国政府尊重人民自由，美国为20%。仍偏负面的地区：日本、以色列、美国、韩国、瑞典对中国不好感超70%；新加坡是'富裕即负面'规律的明显例外（调查国中人均GDP最高但对中国好感高于中位）。对仪表盘的意义：这是美方首次在中位好感度竞赛中输给中国，印证了'美元体系侵蚀+美国同盟张力'这一链条环节。下次调查预计2026年底/2027年。更新于 2026-09-20
